A bakehouse that belongs to West End

Samuel Bakehouse opened on Saturday 19 September 2026 at 132 Boundary Street, in the former Lekki by Little Lagos space. It is a Korean influenced bakehouse, built around sourdough, pastries and coffee.

Owner Lee Kim has spoken about wanting the bakehouse integrated into the community it serves. That idea is the short version of the whole place: made with time, and shared with the community.

On the coffee side, barista Karl brings a rare eye to the bar. He is a national and international brewers judge, and the pour over is brewed by hand at the counter.
